example: The committee will address the safety concerns at Monday's meeting.
example_zh: 委員會將在週一的會議上處理安全疑慮。
note: 常見意思是「地址」，多益裡多半當動詞「處理、應付」。

example: Please book a conference room for twelve people.
example_zh: 請預訂一間可容納十二人的會議室。
note: 不是「書」，當動詞是「預訂」。

example: The board decided to table the proposal until the next quarter.
example_zh: 董事會決定將該提案擱置到下一季。
note: 當動詞是「把議案擱在桌上」＝暫緩討論。

example: The bank will issue your replacement card within five business days.
example_zh: 銀行將在五個工作天內核發你的補發卡片。
note: 常見意思是「議題」，動詞則是「發放、核發」。

example: We figure the renovation will take about three weeks.
example_zh: 我們認為整修大約要花三週。
note: 除了「數字、人物」，口語中常作「認為」。

example: She has run the family restaurant for over twenty years.
example_zh: 她經營這家家族餐廳超過二十年。
note: 不是「跑」，商務語境多為「經營」。

example: Could you cover my shift on Friday afternoon?
example_zh: 你可以幫我代週五下午的班嗎？
note: 除了「覆蓋、涵蓋」，職場常指「代班」。

example: Ms. Lin is in charge of the overseas shipping department.
example_zh: 林女士負責海外運輸部門。
note: in charge of＝負責；charge 另有「收費、指控」之意。

example: Both parties signed the contract on Tuesday.
example_zh: 雙方當事人於週二簽署合約。
note: 法律與合約文件中指「當事一方」，不是「派對」。

example: The manager kept the visiting client company during lunch.
example_zh: 經理在午餐時陪伴來訪的客戶。
note: 除了「公司」，也可指「陪伴」。

example: The startup raised enough capital to expand into Asia.
example_zh: 這家新創募得足夠資金以拓展到亞洲。
note: 不只是「首都、大寫」，商務中多指「資金」。

example: The new assembly plant will open in March.
example_zh: 新的組裝工廠將於三月啟用。
note: 除了「植物」，製造業語境指「廠房」。

example: The board approved the annual budget without objection.
example_zh: 董事會無異議通過年度預算。
note: board 可作董事會、木板，動詞則是「登上（交通工具）」。

example: We appreciate that the deadline is tight for your team.
example_zh: 我們理解這個期限對貴團隊來說很趕。
note: 除了「感激、增值」，也有「明白、體認」之意。

example: All visitors must observe the safety regulations on site.
example_zh: 所有訪客都必須遵守現場的安全規定。
note: 除了「觀察」，正式文件中常是「遵守」。

example: The firm retains all records for at least seven years.
example_zh: 該公司所有紀錄至少保留七年。

example: Please submit your expense report by the end of the month.
example_zh: 請在月底前提交你的報帳單。

example: The supervisor approved the budget increase this morning.
example_zh: 主管今天早上核准了預算增加。

example: The training session was postponed due to a scheduling conflict.
example_zh: 因為時間衝突，訓練課程被延期了。

example: The company will implement the new policy next quarter.
example_zh: 公司將於下一季實施新政策。

example: Our team negotiated a lower rate with the supplier.
example_zh: 我們團隊與供應商協商到更低的價格。

example: The assistant distributed the handouts before the presentation.
example_zh: 助理在簡報前分發了講義。

example: We anticipate a rise in demand during the holiday season.
example_zh: 我們預期假期期間需求會上升。

example: Only the director can authorize overtime payments.
example_zh: 只有總監可以授權加班費。

example: All departments must comply with the updated guidelines.
example_zh: 所有部門都必須遵守更新後的準則。
note: comply 後面接 with。

example: The company will reimburse travel expenses within two weeks.
example_zh: 公司將在兩週內報銷差旅費用。

example: Management allocated additional funds to the research team.
example_zh: 管理層撥出額外資金給研究團隊。

example: The new software streamlines the ordering process.
example_zh: 新軟體精簡了訂購流程。

example: Please verify the shipping address before confirming the order.
example_zh: 確認訂單前請先核實寄送地址。

example: The invoice has been outstanding for over a month.
example_zh: 這張發票已經超過一個月未付。
note: 常見意思是「傑出的」，帳務語境是「未付清的」。

example: We have a tentative agreement pending legal review.
example_zh: 我們有一份暫定協議，待法務審查。

example: Attendance at the orientation is mandatory for new hires.
example_zh: 新進員工必須參加職前說明會。

example: Employees are eligible for the bonus after one full year.
example_zh: 員工滿一整年後才有資格領取獎金。
note: eligible for something。

example: Thank you for your prompt response to our inquiry.
example_zh: 感謝你迅速回覆我們的詢問。
note: 除了「提示」，形容詞是「迅速的」。

example: Data entry can be tedious without the right tools.
example_zh: 沒有合適工具，資料輸入會很乏味。

example: Subsequent meetings will be held every other Friday.
example_zh: 後續會議將每隔一週的週五舉行。

example: The preliminary results suggest strong customer interest.
example_zh: 初步結果顯示客戶興趣濃厚。

example: The merger brought a substantial increase in revenue.
example_zh: 這樁併購帶來可觀的營收成長。

example: We take inventory at the warehouse every quarter.
example_zh: 我們每季在倉庫盤點庫存。

example: The travel agent emailed a detailed itinerary this morning.
example_zh: 旅行社今早寄來一份詳細行程表。

example: Smoking is not permitted anywhere on the premises.
example_zh: 場所內任何地方都禁止吸菸。
note: 常用複數，指「房舍、營業場所」。

example: Most of our new clients come from referrals.
example_zh: 我們多數新客戶來自轉介推薦。

example: The laptop comes with a two-year warranty.
example_zh: 這台筆電附有兩年保固。

example: Please keep the receipt for your records.
example_zh: 請保留收據以備查核。
note: upon receipt of＝一收到就…。

example: We compared quotes from three different vendors.
example_zh: 我們比較了三家不同供應商的報價。

example: The deadline for submissions is next Wednesday.
example_zh: 投稿截止期限是下週三。

example: Routine maintenance is scheduled for every second Sunday.
example_zh: 例行保養安排在每隔一個週日。
